description: Header file defining structures, functions, and constants for color transformation effects in shaders, including the LinearEffect struct and related functions for building shader code and uniforms.

classes.name: LinearEffect
classes.description: Structure representing arguments for creating a color transformation effect in shaders, including dataspace settings and effect type.

classes.name: LinearEffectHasher
classes.description: Hasher struct for LinearEffect, used for hashing instances based on their properties.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator for LinearEffect, compares all fields for equality.

methods.name: HashCombine
methods.description: Static method to combine hash values, inspired by boost::hash_combine.

methods.name: buildLinearEffectSkSL
methods.description: Function to generate shader code string applying color transforms in linear space.

methods.name: buildLinearEffectUniforms
methods.description: Function to generate a list of shader uniforms for the LinearEffect shader.
